headline: Investigation into social media manipulation in the stock market: suspicious accounts under scrutiny | Economy
summary: The Bakırköy Chief Public Prosecutor's Office opened an investigation into social media accounts allegedly posting misleading content to influence prices of capital market instruments and steer investors.
why: Market manipulation probes by prosecutors and securities regulators protect investor confidence in exchange-listed assets such as those on Borsa Istanbul.
